scope: Thirteen remaining pathology-readout source bodies with bounded four-parent/eight-native context, not a repeated exhaustive ordinary-lesson audit. Source-first within this phase, with prior related stromal/source knowledge explicitly retained; not blind independent acceptance.

units.requirement: A thin tissue section represents one depth and finite selected material; nearby depths can have different mixtures, not a full tissue census.

Hematoxylin broadly highlights nuclei and nucleic-acid-rich structures blue-purple; eosin broadly stains cytoplasm/extracellular components pink-red. These are not sequence or named-protein measurements.

Cell forms and architectural relationships need represented interfaces and expert/contextual interpretation; one pixel, nucleus or generic cluster does not establish diagnosis, invasion or every death mechanism.
Simplified stain colours, intensity and generic cell appearance are not receptor abundance, gene activity, cell viability or a molecular inventory; diagram geometry is schematic.

Sectioning/staining can have fixation, damage, missing-interface and sampling limits. Direct morphology, a specific molecular assay and a research computational prediction have different validation scopes.
In the fictional pink-setting/receptor-R exercise, appearance supplies architectural context but does not demonstrate the named receptor or drug benefit.
IHC uses antibody-based detection of selected proteins with tissue and cell-compartment context; specificity, preparation, background and controls require validation.
The fictional common denominator has 100 eligible cells: 50 unstained, 10 weak, 20 moderate and 20 strong. Positive fraction is 50 percent and weighted H-score is 10+40+60=110.
The stated H-score convention weights percentages by 1, 2 and 3, includes unstained cells at weight zero and has scale 0–300; it is an index, not a molecule count or percent scale.
Positive fraction and intensity weighting retain different information; an equal H-score can hide different distributions. All eligible categories remain in the denominator.
The 100 circles and category rows are invented bookkeeping, not spatial tissue geography or a mandatory imaging/cell-counting workflow.

Allred is a separate conventional categorical proportion-plus-intensity system with possible totals zero and 2–8. In its separate 30-percent uniformly moderate example, proportion category 3 plus intensity 2 gives 5; this is not the 50-percent H-score sample.
A generic composite, positive stain or negative clinical category does not establish exact molecules, activity, accessibility, dependence, a universal cutoff or individual treatment benefit.

Retain scored cells, compartment, clone, retrieval/detection, denominator, scale, controls, specimen and intended use; finite tissue and heterogeneity/variation limit measurement and clinical transfer.

Under the stated breast 22C3 CPS method, eligible stained tumour cells, lymphocytes and macrophages enter the numerator; all viable invasive tumour cells, including unstained ones, are the denominator, with immune cells excluded from it.
Qualifying tumour staining is convincing partial/complete membrane staining; eligible immune-cell staining can be membrane and/or cytoplasmic under the method.

Immune-cell eligibility requires the specified invasive-tumour/associated-stromal context and exclusions. Not every stained immune cell qualifies; neutrophils, nonviable cells and benign/in-situ-only populations are excluded under the stated manual.

The fictional inventory has 200 viable tumour cells including 20 stained and 180 unstained, plus 40 eligible stained lymphocytes and 20 eligible stained macrophages: CPS is 40 and tumour-cell staining fraction is 10 percent.
Reported CPS is capped at 100 under the specified method. CPS 100 does not require every tumour cell to stain, and CPS is not the positive fraction of all cells.
The cited TNBC 22C3 method requires at least 100 viable tumour cells and valid controls/adequacy. This technical method is not itself a current jurisdictional treatment authorization.

TPS is a qualifying tumour-cell membrane-staining percentage with immune cells excluded from its numerator; applying its arithmetic requires its assay/disease rules and does not make it interchangeable with CPS.
IC scoring is an eligible PD-L1-stained immune-cell area fraction of tumour area under its named assay, not a tumour-cell fraction or CPS numerator over viable tumour cells.
Grouped fictional inventories do not supply microscopic spatial eligibility decisions. Stained populations, control adequacy and cell attribution still require the actual method.

Assay clone, platform, preparation, scoring algorithm, specimen and clinical setting constrain a score. No generic score switch, universal cutoff, personal benefit prediction or recertification of retained clinical trials follows.

The pretreatment breast stromal TIL method uses eligible tumour-associated stroma within invasive borders and mononuclear infiltrate including lymphocytes/plasma cells; malignant nests and method-defined excluded regions do not enter the eligible denominator.
Post-neoadjuvant residual-bed regional guidance is distinct from pretreatment invasive-tumour stroma; retain treatment setting, specimen and method.
In the invented common-scale area map, A has four eligible units with 0.4 occupied and B one with 0.6. Pooled fraction is 1/5=20 percent; an unweighted mean of 10 and 60 percent is 35 percent.
The pooled-area toy arithmetic is not a mandatory clinical pixel workflow. Actual scoring is trained, semiquantitative and overall, rather than choosing only hotspots.

Stromal-area percent, positive-cell percent, cells per square millimetre, selected-cell count and bulk immune RNA are distinct measurements; none alone proves specificity, killing or universal immunotherapy benefit.

Retain tissue/block, sampled site, treatment context, eligible regions, exclusions, observer/computational method, units and calibration. Measurement reproducibility, heterogeneity and clinical-use validation are separate.
All thirteen assigned bodies were read in full at the original pin; later entries reuse exact whole-byte identity, with both inventories retained.

Historical PASS and independent-review labels are claims at stated scope. Review-pending provenance can predate a later receipt; none is fresh independent, expert, owner, learner or language acceptance.
Original creators, task authors, route-insertion authors, reviewers and integrators retain distinct roles; historical model-call counts and actor strings are not reconstructed as creative proof.
Private capture paths and historical source commits are not followed or fetched. Public/current, candidate, preimage and private hash assertions retain distinct meanings.
Provenance alt/caption strings are compared with pinned owner copy and gain no duplicate scientific credit. Toy values and identities are invented, with no patient case copied.

Eligible parent bodies and complete version diffs are read after frontmatter/generated-navigation/personal-case exclusions. PD-L1 acronym, Mermaid and IC output-row changes remain explicit; ordinary grades are not replaced.
Historical raw-source/whole-paper claims are not inherited as fresh reads. Unselected clinical cohort and authorization assertions retain their old depth.

Eight whole native SVG variants were viewed, with whole DOM checks still to do. Fresh views do not establish browser/hydration/mobile, measured contrast or accessibility acceptance; Mermaid source reading is not a rendered-diagram review.

Historical focus-return-to-BODY and human-review limits remain open. The stromal rectangle/pink-nest overlap is a possible illustrative ambiguity for the artwork owner, not a revised clinical finding.
